Use case: logo-brand. Production transparent wordmark asset for FoodJury.
Text exactly: "FoodJury". One word, capital F and J. Reference image provides brand colors and retro diner style only; do not include the character or any other part of the board.
Create an exceptional 1950s American diner sign lettering wordmark: bold connected italic brush script, thick smooth ivory cream letter faces, strong midnight navy outline and short hard navy down-right extruded shadow. Capital F has a graceful short swash and capital J has a descending curved tail. Lettering rises subtly left to right, energetic, friendly, and remarkably readable. Wide landscape artwork 3:1 aspect, wordmark occupies width with comfortable 5% padding. This will appear on a blazing orange app header at 200 logical pixels wide; keep the lettering bold and immediately legible.
